title: Detailed lithologic logs from auger holes in southern Charleston County, southwestern Dorchester County, and eastern Colleton County, South Carolina
citation: Weems, R.E., and Lewis, W.C., 2019, Detailed lithologic logs from auger holes in southern Charleston County, southwestern Dorchester County, and eastern Colleton County, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2019-1119, map scale 1:554,000.
notes:
Auger-hole logs (Appendix 1) transcribed row by row: unit = the stratigraphic heading above each row; depths in feet below land surface (column header DEPTH, IN FEET); 'at N' rows are single-depth events (hard beds, refusal). Each log's 'Base of <unit>: N ft below sea level' summary lines and 'Bottomed in' lines were not recorded (no schema field). BP-1 0-1 ft is fill with no unit heading. EI-4 continues into packet-02. Coordinates are NAD27 per Methods (p. 8). Figures 1-2 (pp. 12-13) are location maps with no readable text.
Auger-hole logs (Appendix 1, pp. 47-86) transcribed row by row: unit = the stratigraphic heading above each row; depths in feet (column header DEPTH, IN FEET); 'at N' rows are single-depth events. First observation continues log EI-4 from packet-01 (label cited from p. 46). Rows of road fill/disturbed soil have no unit heading. 'Base of <unit>' elevation summaries and 'Bottomed in' lines not recorded (no schema field).
Auger-hole logs (Appendix 1, pp. 87-123) transcribed row by row: unit = the stratigraphic heading above each row; depths in feet (column header DEPTH, IN FEET). Rows of road fill/disturbed soil have no unit heading. 'Base of <unit>' elevation summaries and 'Bottomed in' lines not recorded (no schema field). Nannofossil zone notes (NP 19/20, NP 24, NP 24/25, NP 21) stay inside the interval descriptions.
Auger-hole logs (Appendix 1, pp. 124-136) transcribed row by row: unit = the stratigraphic heading above each row; depths in feet (column header DEPTH, IN FEET). WA-3 has no UNCONFORMITY lines between its unit headings. WA-4 7-9 ft row reads 'Sit, clayey' in the source (kept verbatim). 'Base of <unit>' elevation summaries and 'Bottomed in' lines not recorded (no schema field).
